missingness_rules.unknown_statistics: Blank/unknown values remain missing and are counted as missing; they are never filled with zero.
missingness_rules.rankings: Both players must have positive match/effective ranking values to count as available.
missingness_rules.odds: A stage is available only when both players have valid decimal prices greater than 1.
missingness_rules.exact_time_fields: No source currently provides verified match start timezone, result availability timestamp or individual odds quote timestamps. Date-only match-day coverage is separate.
missingness_rules.history_depth: Minimum of the two players’ pre-match prior_match counts in the published pre-match main-tour feature table; counts from this feature population only.

date_limitations: event_date is generally a tournament start date and is not an exact match timestamp.
The Valuebetennis date and opening/last-pre-match labels are provider-reported; quote timestamps and timezone were not provided.
A blank date or timestamp is not inferred from match duration, round, event schedule, or assumed delays.
